about_pullquote: I paint homes like I'd paint my own—careful, honest, and always on time.
about_para_1: D.M.S Painting & Decorating was founded two decades ago on a simple belief: that a fresh coat of paint shouldn't cost the earth or take forever. Started by Derek, a time-served decorator who got tired of seeing overpriced, rushed jobs, the business has grown by word-of-mouth recommendation alone. Today we're the go-to painters for Southampton families and businesses who want quality without the fuss.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up when we say we will, delivering the finish we promised, and treating your home with respect. We take pride in the detail—protecting your furniture, cleaning up properly, and never cutting corners on preparation. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and their friends, which tells you everything you need to know.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About D.M.S

reviews.text: Derek came round, gave us a fair quote, and turned up exactly when he said. Painted our whole lounge in a day and you'd never know he'd been here except for the lovely new walls. Tidy worker, professional, and actually listens to what you want. Definitely using him again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We'd had our kitchen looking tired for ages. Derek helped us pick a colour scheme that we weren't sure about, and it looks amazing now. The wallpapering in the dining room is perfect—no bubbles, no gaps. Really pleased. Thanks lads.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Had the external woodwork done—soffits, fascias, doors. Quality of work is exceptional. No mess left behind, and the finish is rock solid. Honest pricing and they got on with it without any drama. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Robert K.
